newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CANAL PLUS , S.AFRICA'S NETHOLD SIGN DEAL.
newsitem.headline: CANAL PLUS , S.AFRICA'S NETHOLD SIGN DEAL.

text.p: MIH Holdings said on Thursday that definitive agreements relating to the merger of the European interests of Network Holdings Ltd and France's Canal Plus have been signed.
MIH Holdings Ltd has a 40 percent interest in Nethold, which is jointly held by South African industrial holding firm Richemont SA and MCL-Multi Choice Ltd.

Under the ageement, Nethold will transfer its African operations to MIH. Thereafter, Canal Plus will acquire 100 percent of Nethold shares to be satisfied by the issue of about 20 percent of the enlarged share capital of Canal Plus.
